"How should our parks be looked after for the next twenty years?"

Important dates for the Citizens' Assembly:

  • Monday 26 October: We will notify you by email and/or phone if you have been selected, and arrange a short phone call to discuss any questions you may have.
  • Monday 2 November: We will notify you by email if you have not been selected.
  • Saturday 21 November: First session of the assembly
